AmdGold_XAUUSD_Demo.basis: Fixed before the bot places its first Demo order (the user's call on 2026-10-09, ahead of the 20-30 paper trades the module docstring asked for, so the rule is deliberately tight). Bootstrap envelope (100000 draws, seed 20261009, scripts/amd_backtest.envelope) of scripts/amd_backtest.py on CFI's XAUUSD_ history, 2024-01-29..2026-10-06: 66 trades, PF 2.249, +26.4R, launcher flags (2R, min FVG 0.5, spread floor 0.15). The bot trades about two setups a month, so the windows are 20 and 40 trades, not the breakout bot's 40 and 80: p99 max drawdown 7.1R/20 and 8.6R/40, p05 net -0.4R at trade 20; the adopted values are rounded down to 7.0, 8.5 and -0.4 (stricter). Costs: spread charged, no swap (flat 15:55 New York), no commission on CFI. The 2024 sub-period alone is PF 1.10 (20 trades) and 2025-26 carries the edge, so a bad first 20 live trades is a real possibility, not a tail event.
